resources.string: Gives a keyboard microphone-button tap priority over Jarvis listening. Checks only the tapped control’s label or ID in your selected keyboard. Does not read typed text or pause for keyboard visibility. Jarvis resumes automatically after recording ends.

Lets Jarvis see the current screen and, during a task you approve, tap buttons, scroll lists and type into fields. Jarvis pauses while you touch the screen and shows a floating Stop button until the task ends.
